content:
We have functional groups list. For carbonyl-ene reverse, we break ketone (functional group "ketones") and break C-C double bond ("C-C double bonds") and form aliphatic hydroxyl ("aliphatic hydroxyls"). So we can search with those.

Let's call search_template_catalog_by_criteria with functional_groups_broken ["ketones","C-C double bonds"], functional_groups_formed ["aliphatic hydroxyls"].
